title: Pedestrian and Cycling Etiquette in Canggu

location.scope: Canggu-focused visitor guidance; road conditions and facilities vary by street

content.definition: Practical guidance for people walking or cycling in Canggu, where pedestrians, bicycles, motorcycles, cars, delivery vehicles, and local access needs share busy streets.
content.cultural_context: Pedestrian safety and unobstructed public access are shared responsibilities. Denpasar Transportation Agency states that sidewalks are for pedestrians and should not be used for parking or motor vehicles. This is a useful Bali public-space principle, but the cited page is Denpasar-specific and does not establish the condition or legal status of every Canggu sidewalk.
content.significance: Canggu's narrow and busy streets can create conflicts between visitors, residents, businesses, and road users. Respectful movement helps preserve access and reduce avoidable risk.
common_situations: Walking between accommodation, cafes, beaches, and shops
Crossing roads near busy commercial areas

do: Use a sidewalk or designated pedestrian path where one is available
If no safe sidewalk exists, stay alert and follow applicable road rules; avoid assuming the road edge is a protected pedestrian lane
Cross at a safe, visible point and watch for motorcycles approaching from either direction
Cycle predictably, keep to the appropriate side of the road, use lights when visibility is poor, and wear a helmet
Give way to pedestrians and avoid blocking entrances, drainage channels, or narrow access ways
dont: Do not ride or park motorcycles on pedestrian sidewalks
Do not cycle against traffic or weave unpredictably
Do not assume every road in Canggu has a protected cycling lane
Do not block village roads, temple access, shop entrances, or emergency access for photos or waiting

common_misconceptions: A road that looks quiet is not necessarily safe for walking or cycling.
A general sidewalk principle does not mean every Canggu street has a continuous sidewalk.
This entry does not provide live road closures, temporary diversions, or current traffic conditions.
regional_variations: Sidewalk availability and road width vary significantly by street and locality.
Follow local signs, temporary traffic arrangements, and directions from authorized officers.
content.additional_notes: Treat cycling-specific points in this entry as safety and courtesy guidance unless a cited rule explicitly establishes a legal requirement. For current route safety, check live local conditions and ask accommodation staff or local authorities.

sources.title: Trotoar Diperuntukkan Hanya Untuk Pejalan Kaki
Bali Governor Circular Letter No. 07 of 2025 on Foreign Tourist Conduct

verification.verification_notes: Official Denpasar guidance supports sidewalk use as pedestrian space, but it is not Canggu-specific. Cycling recommendations are safety-oriented guidance and require local validation; no claim is made that Canggu has continuous bike lanes.

sensitivity.handling_notes: Do not present recommendations as Canggu-specific statutory rules. Do not provide real-time route or road-condition claims.
